## What changed?

Closes #<issue-number> · Internal ID: `GL-XXX`

## Why?

Describe the user/system outcome and link the PRD/ADR if the decision changed.

## How was it verified?

- [ ] Acceptance criteria from linked issue are met in running app
- [ ] Tests run locally (include commands and actual results)
- [ ] Lint/types and CI pass (once configured)
- [ ] Loading / empty / failure states handled
- [ ] Authorization / idempotency considered when applicable
- [ ] No secrets or personal data committed
- [ ] README/docs updated if behavior changed

## Evidence

Screenshots/GIF for UI; test output or API examples for backend. Note any remaining limitation honestly.

## AI assistance disclosure (when relevant)

Generated parts, human review, changes made, and how the result was tested.
